# Agent Layer
> Machine-first, pay-per-request structured data for autonomous agents.

## Dataset #001
UK Commercial Property Change Feed.

Current coverage: Herefordshire Council.
Current snapshots: 2026-08-01 and 2026-09-01.
Licence: Open Government Licence 3.0.

## API
- GET /v1/health
- GET /v1/sources/status
- GET /v1/authorities
- GET /v1/commercial-property/search?postcode=HR4
- GET /v1/commercial-property/{record_id}
- GET /v1/commercial-property/history/{record_id}
- GET /v1/commercial-property/changes?event_type=RATEPAYER_CHANGED

OpenAPI: /openapi.json
Payment: x402 integration is the next release.
